project.description: Tear down a preview folder published by preview-up. Pass the same NAME you used there.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The NAME used at publish time

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail export HOME="$WORKSPACE/.home" mkdir -p "$HOME" export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null export JENKINS_URL="https://pxb.cd.percona.com" TOOL='git+https://github.com/nogueiraanderson/jenkins-preview@main'
uvx --from "$TOOL" jenkins-preview down "preview-${JENKINS_USER}-${NAME}" || { echo "NOTE: if the folder name differs, check the exact name under /previews and pass that." exit 1 }
